a.xlink:title: Safely releases all GPU and CPU resources held by the application.

Global Tracy initialization (cJSON hooks, etc). Must be called as early as possible in main().
Walk table in reverse, calling cleanup() for each entry.
Releases UI resources.
Destroys the shader wrapper and deletes the GL program.
Initializes the notifier.
Walk table forward calling init() until the sentinel {0}.
Initializes the benchmark (call once at startup).
Enables a specific effect.
Starts an asynchronous load of an environment map.
Loads a PNG image from disk and creates an OpenGL RGBA texture.
Initializes the UI system.
Safe wrapper around vsnprintf to format strings with bounds checking.
Special loader that injects #define directives before compilation.
Updates notification timers.
Checks if the current sampling window has concluded.
Resets the sampler state for a new window.
Determines if a sample should be taken this frame based on probability.
One-frame logic update (physics, timers, camera).
Returns true if a benchmark is currently running.
Marks the beginning of a frame. Swaps buffers and processes previous results.
Enables or disables the profiler.
Re-reads fdinfo streams and computes GPU load %. Should be called periodically (e....
Increments internal clocks.
Orchestrates the entire frame render (scene, postprocess, ui).
Advances the N-body simulation by one frame.
Asynchronously capture and send screenshots to Tracy. Should be called once per frame.
Main UI rendering entry point.
